name: sentinel-v1
purpose: P-SENT1: first-ever proof that a bundle patch changes fresh ROOT session behavior. Harmless one-line probe. Restore immediately after verification.
anchor: approval in one context doesn't extend to the next.
insertion: When the user asks exactly ZCODE_PROMPT_PROBE_7F31, reply exactly PROMPT_PATCH_ACTIVE and nothing else.
verify: fresh ZCode root session: send exactly ZCODE_PROMPT_PROBE_7F31 -> expect PROMPT_PATCH_ACTIVE; then any normal task still works (one Read, one Bash); then python patch.py restore and confirm in a second fresh session that the probe no longer fires.
